This is the same unchanged diagnostic previously verified FALSE_POSITIVE on main as AaHaPjgoSajQlY95HQkw. false_positives.source_contract: Commands() creates a local Fixture initializer_list whose token members are exactly "value", "const", and "color" string literals. const auto& fixture never writes or rebinds them. All three pointers address compiler-provided trailing NUL characters and static storage. std::strlen consumes that direct literal pointer before passing the length to SetSel; no file, document text, external input, or mutable buffer can supply token. Each literal occurs in its paired before literal, so the independently reviewed selection is bounded by the matching fixture text. PR224 only unqualified Message::SetSel and did not alter either strlen or its operands.
